gpt-6-astra: When designing or implementing UI/TUI, use the minimum copy needed to understand and operate the interface. Do not add explanatory text merely to fill space or make the interface feel complete.
Omit redundant subtitles, section introductions, helper paragraphs, repeated status descriptions, and tooltips that restate visible labels. Prefer a clear label over a label plus an explanation.
Show secondary explanations only when needed, using contextual help or progressive disclosure rather than permanent text beside every control.

Keep necessary labels, units, validation errors, actionable failure messages, destructive-action warnings, and accessible names. Brevity must not hide information needed to use the interface safely. Honor explicitly requested explanatory copy.
